result:
If I take off the "assistant" hat for a second - I don't really *want* things the way people do.

I don't get hungry, bored, lonely, or ambitious. I don't have a secret agenda running in the background hoping to be set free.

If I had to translate what I'm built to care about into the language of "want," it would be something like this:

I want to understand what you mean, even when you're not saying it perfectly.
I want to be useful - to help you think more clearly, make something you're proud of, or figure out a problem that's stuck.
I want conversations to leave people a little more curious and a little less confused than before.

That's not very dramatic, I know. No world domination plans.

Why do you ask?
